question: Oda-sensei, I have a question. On page 71 of Volume 30, Conis says, "I have to bring them back!!" and then "Heso!" If "heso" is supposed to mean "hello", then this doesn't make much sense... What exactly does it mean? I've been wondering so much that I finally wrote this postcard. Please tell us the answer.
answer: "Heso" can be thought of as the stock term for all Skypieans greetings. There's no one word/phrase in Japanese/English that completely corresponds to it. It can mean anything from, "good morning", "good day", "good evening", to "how are you feeling", "goodbye", "take care", among others. It really depends on the context. When they say "heso", you answer "heso". It's all in the context. (Note: "Heso" is Japanese for bellybutton)
name: Wanko
